mapper.select:
SELECT DATE(recent.create_time) AS browse_date, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( "spuId", recent.spu_id, "createTime", DATE_FORMAT(recent.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), "spuUrls", SUBSTRING_INDEX(gs.spu_urls, ',', 1), "name", gs.name, "stock", gs.stock, "salesPrice", gs.sales_price, "originalPrice", gs.original_price ) ) AS items FROM (
SELECT gf.spu_id, MAX(gf.create_time) AS create_time FROM goods_footprint AS gf WHERE gf.user_id = #{query.userId} AND gf.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY gf.spu_id ) AS recent LEFT JOIN goods_spu AS gs ON gs.id = recent.spu_id GROUP BY browse_date ORDER BY browse_date DESC
